changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.why: If an administrator issued this password, you must choose your own before you can use the system.
changePassword.rule: At least 10 characters. No upper-case or symbol rules — length is what matters. It must not be your username.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match

adminUsers.title: Users and access
adminUsers.createWhy: The new account must change this password at first sign-in. A PIN is optional and enables the fast terminal switch.
adminUsers.rule: Password: at least 10 characters, not the username. PIN: 4 to 6 digits.
adminUsers.twoAdminWarning: Fewer than two people on this deployment hold the full auth.* set — {{n}} today. A password reset may only be performed by somebody who holds everything the target holds, so below TWO such people a forgotten password at the top has no repair but direct database access. Add a second person and give them the admin role.
adminUsers.noRoles: none — this person can reach nothing
adminUsers.allRolesHeld: Holds every role on this deployment
adminUsers.roleAssigned: {{roleKey}} was assigned to {{username}} — it takes effect on their next action
adminUsers.grantsAccessAuthority: This role carries authority over access itself: who exists, who may do what, and whose password can be reset. Give it only to someone you would trust with the hospital's accounts.
adminUsers.inertScope: — grants nothing today; every route requires hospital scope. Revoke and re-assign at hospital scope.
adminUsers.resetPasswordWhy: Every session this person holds will be signed out, and they must choose their own password at the next sign-in.
adminUsers.resetPinWhy: The PIN changes and nothing else. Sessions stay signed in.
adminUsers.passwordReset: {{username}}'s password was reset and their sessions were signed out
adminUsers.reactivated: {{username}} was reactivated — they can sign in again

error.admin_lockout: Refused: this would leave nobody able to administer users. Give somebody else that authority first.
error.user_not_found: That person no longer exists — reload the list
error.role_not_found: That role does not exist on this deployment — reload the list

partnerReceivables.noIdentity: This desk works from a partner's statement. It shows referral slips, amounts and dates — never a patient's name, UHID or phone.

partnerReceivables.statementWhy: Every line is matched by id. A line quoting a slip we never issued, or another partner's slip, is disputed rather than paid.
